title: ICJ Orders Provisional Measures in South Africa v. Israel
reason: The ICJ issued provisional measures on January 26, 2024, ordering Israel to take all measures to prevent acts of genocide in Gaza; the court did not order a ceasefire but required Israel to ensure its military did not commit acts under Article II of the Genocide Convention.

title: Mass Displacement and Famine Warnings in Gaza
reason: By mid-2024, approximately 1.9 million of Gaza's 2.3 million residents had been displaced; IPC analyses confirmed famine was imminent in northern Gaza by early 2024, with the entire strip facing acute food insecurity classified at IPC Phase 3 or worse.

title: Multiple Countries Recognize State of Palestine
reason: Norway, Ireland, Spain, and Slovenia formally recognized the State of Palestine in May-June 2024 (Spain, Ireland, Norway on May 28; Slovenia on June 4), reflecting European frustration with the peace process and the scale of destruction in Gaza.

title: Gaza Ceasefire Negotiations Continue Amid Ongoing Operations
reason: A January 2025 ceasefire deal brokered by Qatar, Egypt, and the US collapsed in March 2025 when Israel resumed operations; subsequent negotiations through mid-2025 continued with Hamas and Israel exchanging counter-proposals, with hostage release as the central obstacle.
